definitions.name: U2D.NTRUE
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> how many are TRUE

definitions.name: U2D.WHERE
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: values truths (equal length) -> the values at TRUE positions, in order

definitions.name: U2D.SUMBY
definitions.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys values -> Record from each distinct key (first-appearance order) to the sum of its values

definitions.name: U2D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES U1A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> the key with the largest value, first on ties

definitions.name: U2D.LEDGER
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP U2D.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record name -> total amount, names in first-appearance order

definitions.name: U2D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'K' BIND 1 K RANGE [ 'D' BIND K D DIV FLOOR D MUL K EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> its positive divisors ascending

definitions.name: U2D.ISPRIME
definitions.note: positive integer -> TRUE when prime (1 is not)

definitions.name: U2D.BITS
definitions.body: [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB
definitions.note: integer 0..63 -> its six binary digits as numbers, most significant first

definitions.name: U2D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 0 2 COLLECT 'A' BIND 0 129 RANGE A [ 'EL' BIND [ 'C' 'S' ] BIND C C 2 DIV C 3 MUL 1 ADD C 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL C EQ SELECT C 1 EQ SELECT S S 1 ADD C 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: positive integer (at most 130 steps needed) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: U2D.FIBS
definitions.body: 0 59 RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'EL' BIND [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND B A B ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: pushes the Vector of the first 60 Fibonacci numbers F(1)=1, F(2)=1, F(3)=2, ...

definitions.name: U2D.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON String with an orders array -> Vector of order Records

definitions.name: U2D.REVENUE
definitions.body: U2D.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP G0A.SUM
definitions.note: JSON orders String -> total of qty times price over the orders that have a price

definitions.name: U2D.QTYS
definitions.body: 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP U2D.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in first-appearance order

definitions.name: U2D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: U2D.ABS
definitions.note: number or Vector of numbers -> absolute value, lane by lane

definitions.name: U2D.DEVS
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> each number minus the mean, in order

definitions.name: U2D.VAR
definitions.body: U2D.DEVS 'D' BIND D D MUL G0A.MEAN

solutions.ledger.debtors: U2D.LEDGER 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 0 LT U2D.WHERE
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'L' BIND L L [ 1 GET ] MAP U1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ U1B.CAP1 ] MAP U1A.UNWORDS
solutions.number.binary: U2D.BITS STR JOIN 'S' BIND S CHARS S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
solutions.number.digital_root: 1 SUB 'M' BIND M M 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
solutions.number.fib_index: 'N' BIND U2D.FIBS N LT U2D.NTRUE 1 ADD
solutions.orders.unpriced: U2D.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: U2D.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V V U2D.MEDIAN SUB U2D.ABS U2D.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.stats.range: SORT 'S' BIND S -1 GET S 0 GET SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND V S 0 GET SUB S -1 GET S 0 GET SUB DIV
solutions.text.longest: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
